description: This file contains a helper function for converting BBCode markup into HTML. It defines a function `oc_bbcode_decode` that applies multiple regex patterns to convert BBCode tags such as [b], [i], [u], [quote], [code], [s], [list], [img], [url], [size], [color], and [youtube] into their corresponding HTML elements.

methods.name: oc_bbcode_decode
methods.description: Converts a string with BBCode markup into HTML by applying a series of regex replacements.
